name: sampler-gear
title: Gear sampler: a gear
description: One of the sampler's gears, marked on top with as many dots as its backlash's place (one for 0.1, two for 0.2, three for 0.3): the mounted assembly sets its module, backlash and dots.

module.rule: Set by the assembly: the pair's row

teeth.rule: The fewest at 20° without a shift

backlash.rule: Set by the assembly: the pair's column

width.rule: Face width, twenty layers, as the plate's pins expect

dots.rule: Set by the assembly: the backlash's place

bore.rule: The plate's 3 mm pin and a line's clearance, so it turns

dot.rule: A marking dot three lines across
